decisions: Use planned modification rather than a new procurement process.
Authorize procurement documents and technical support for procurement and implementation.
Continue smart-lighting pilots and new-product evaluations.
data.description: Planned modification of the HNTB Ohio professional-services agreement for citywide LED conversion and smart controls.
data.name: Smart Lighting Phase 4 modification #2
data.outcome: Authorized up to $499,927.82; identified lifecycle authorization reached $1,675,811.18.

notes: The ordinance identifies EMH&T and Barr Engineering as subconsultants, but the reviewed public text does not disclose their workshare or dollar allocation.

summary: Columbus approved a $499,927.82 planned modification for procurement documents, procurement and implementation support, pilots, and new product evaluations.
